description: Retrieve one MCP integration by id or slug. Returns the full Portkey-side config, including auth type, transport, and masked configuration keys; use get_mcp_integration_metadata for the server's self-reported metadata.

id.description: The MCP integration ID or slug to retrieve

name: get_mcp_integration

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
